scientific_goal: Test whether velocity-adjusted restoring-only orthogonality improves autonomous 0p20 statistics while preserving one TCN drift family across forcing amplitudes.
scientific_constraints: Use only validation repetitions 13 and 14 for selection. Test repetitions 15 and 16 remain locked.

Run the three fresh matched arms with restoring orthogonality weights 0, 1 and 3. Every arm uses the same seed 0 and five epochs. The weight-zero arm is a fresh reproducibility control, not a warm start.

Keep restoring-only diagonal structure, TCN15 with channels 64 / kernel 3 / dilations 1,2,4, full constant diffusion, rank 20, stored 50 Hz high-pass spatial mean, native-lag velocity, and exact 5% training trim fixed. Never switch the drift residual to an MLP.
Keep energy-score weight 0.03, horizons 2,4,10,20, M4 per horizon, batch sampling fraction 0.005, drift-plus-diffusion gradients, batch 256 and learning rate 0.001 fixed.

Only positive restoring-orthogonality arms enable velocity adjustment. This uses the existing frozen training-population position-on-current-velocity regression. Leave explicit damping off, damping orthogonality zero, and joint diagonal-linear orthogonality zero.

This is a soft projection penalty, not a hard constraint or a guarantee of stronger total restoring feedback. Judge actual residual projections, explicit and total coherent-shift response, and generated-history behavior using restoring_audit, alongside the selected-checkpoint training metrics.

The earlier joint position-and-velocity orthogonality trials had explicit damping and weights 10/100. They reduced projection loss but worsened energy/covariance; they do not test this restoring-only proposal. Do not add more joint orthogonality trials.

Use the exact checkpoint-trimmed reference for primary energy and moments. Standard controller PSD and consecutive-increment metrics use untrimmed references: label them as secondary untrimmed diagnostics and never attribute their high-frequency or reversal mismatch to the trimmed target. Do not change the target to untrimmed data.

Screen all three arms on the same 32 full-strength stochastic validation paths for 5000 steps. Run innovation diagnostics and the optional restoring audit on finite screens. Context and trim stay fixed so reference starts and eligible populations are matched.
The reference restoring-only model reached energy 1.508, covariance 1.411 and POD mean error 0.241. A higher stiffness matrix or lower orthogonality penalty alone is not a successful outcome.
Do not add moment losses, MC-GMM, noisy histories, new architectures, new diffusion families, or extra training trials. This study is limited to the three-arm test.
Each training subprocess has a hard 2700-second timeout. Do not resume timed-out partial training.

After all three arms complete, promote at most one positive-weight candidate to 50000 validation steps only if it improves both energy and covariance distance from one relative to the fresh zero-weight control, without a material mean or innovation degradation. Otherwise stop and report the negative result.
advisor_guidance: Complete all three matched initial trials. Review the best-checkpoint validation_restoring_orthogonality fields and restoring_audit measured/generated histories. Compare explicit physical sensitivity with coherent_response for coordinates 1-5; a small projection loss need not prevent residual cancellation under a whole-history shift. The two finite-difference sizes should agree. Do not rank across arms by validation_total_loss because weights differ. Prioritize joint improvement of trimmed energy and covariance, then mean and held-out innovation calibration. Standard PSD/increment metrics remain untrimmed controls. At most one positive-weight arm may receive the 50000-step confirmation; no fourth training trial is authorized. Stop after confirmation or if neither arm improves. Do not request a new implementation or switch architecture.

seed_runs.hypothesis: Existing restoring-only TCN15 without orthogonality; evidence-only reproducibility reference.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Fresh zero-weight control reproduces the existing restoring-only TCN.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Finite rollout near the historical amplitude and covariance baseline.

initial_trials.hypothesis: Velocity-adjusted restoring penalty weight 1 separates restoring feedback from the TCN residual while leaving temporal damping flexible.
initial_trials.expected_observation: Smaller restoring projection and improved total feedback accompany energy and covariance closer to one; a penalty decrease alone is insufficient.
